content.title: BOX Q2 Deep Dive: AI-Powered Upgrades Propel Enterprise Momentum
content.summary: Cloud content management platform Box (NYSE:BOX) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2025, with sales up 8.9% year on year to $294 million. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $298.5 million, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.33 per share was 6.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
